title: Economy’s MAJOR CRACKS: Why the Fed Got Everything Wrong | Danielle DiMartino Booth
speaker: Danielle DiMartino Booth (interviewed by David Lin)

macro_themes.view: FOMC is wrong to be bullish; real growth in AI investment turned to -34.6% in Q2, and since AI was ~100% of GDP growth, a reversal is coming soon.
Unemployment rises in AI-exposed industries; record-low consumer sentiment is hard to lift until people believe AI creates jobs.

notes: Short clip with macro views only; no market or ticker calls.
